description.narrative: (Ethiopia): The USAID Eliminate TB Project (ETBE) provides comprehensive technical support to improve access and utilization of quality TB, drug-resistant TB (DR-TB), and TB/HIV services. With FY 2022 funds, the activity will engage with private health service providers and optimize community-based TB case finding treatment. The activity will also increase access to drug susceptibility testing by expanding the use of rapid TB diagnostic tools and patient-centered TB and DR-TB treatment services and expand treatment for latent TB infection. The activity will strengthen the health systems' referral and care services and strengthen TB research that will inform and guide TB programming...This activity will benefit over 88 million people in six regions of the country: Oromia; Amhara; Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples'; South West Ethiopia Peoples'; Sidama; and Tigray...... . .
